## Context / Problem
The Gerrit Verified matrix intermittently ERRORS during FIXTURE SETUP of tests/unit/test_authorship_batched_ticket_map_7084.py — this time (run 31775418405, py3.13, worker popen-gw1, validating unrelated change 1761) at `git merge -q --no-edit side` with git's output FINALLY captured thanks to change 1619 (the diagnostics fix bug warmthless-dermal-oropendola landed for exactly this purpose):

    error: invalid object 100644 66842fd006b2fdc95ff55a33a263f1cb216bc7d6 for 'aaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd/1005-cccc2222-COMMENT.json'
    fatal: git write-tree failed to write a tree
    exit status 128

This REFINES oropendola's refutation: not a content conflict — the loose blob for the LAST mainline-committed event file is MISSING from the object store two subprocess calls after `git add`+`git commit -q` succeeded on it. A freshly committed object cannot legitimately vanish: this is an object-store integrity fault in the test environment or an env/config leakage between tests, and it will keep blocking UNRELATED changes' Verified votes at random (two distinct tests of this module have now failed the same way).

## Approach
Hypothesis-driven debugging per the /rebar-debug discipline — deterministic reproduction BEFORE any fix. Candidate hypotheses to kill in order:
(a) env leakage into the fixture's subprocess.run (inherits os.environ): GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY / GIT_DIR / GIT_INDEX_FILE / GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES set directly (not via monkeypatch) by another test in the same xdist worker earlier, pointing object writes at a directory later removed;
(b) detached background maintenance (gc --auto autoDetach / git maintenance) spawned by an earlier git call in the same repo pruning or repacking while the fixture continues;
(c) global git config on the runner (CI's "Configure git identity" step or a test writing --global) enabling something destructive;
(d) pytest tmp_path numbering/truncation collision (dir name truncated to 30 chars + _N suffix) causing two fixtures to share a directory under xdist.
Instrument first: a conftest or fixture-level guard that on _GitFailed captures `git fsck`, `ls -la .git/objects/**`, the full os.environ GIT_* set, and any concurrent process listing — so the NEXT CI occurrence pins the mechanism even if local reproduction fails. Then fix the CLASS (e.g., scrub GIT_* env in the fixture's _git via env= allowlist, or disable autoDetach maintenance in the fixture repo), with a regression test proving the mechanism.

## Scope
- tests/unit/test_authorship_batched_ticket_map_7084.py — fixture hardening once the mechanism is proven (env-scrubbed _git and/or maintenance.autoDetach=false), plus any instrumentation that stays useful.
- possibly tests/conftest.py — worker-level GIT_* leak detector if hypothesis (a) is proven.

## Testing
- A deterministic reproduction (stress loop under xdist py3.13, or direct injection of the proven mechanism — e.g., set the leaked env var / trigger detached gc — showing the exact 'invalid object' failure).
- RED->GREEN: the reproduction fails before the fix, passes after.
- The fix must not weaken what the fixture proves (merge topology, --full-history load-bearing case).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Hypotheses (a)-(d) each tested and KILLED with recorded evidence (ticket comments); the mechanism CLASS — ENOENT on a freshly written loose object at merge time — is proven by direct injection, reproducing the CI failure signature byte-for-byte (doubled `invalid object` error, write-tree fatal, rc 128). The organic deleter was not identified after 210 local fixture instantiations under xdist plus ~29,400 prior green executions, so the sanctioned instrumentation path below applies.
- [x] Sanctioned instrumentation path (per this ticket's plan for the not-reproducible case): `_GitFailed` now captures object-store forensics at failure time — `git fsck --full`, `git count-objects -v`, recursive `.git/objects` listing with sizes/mtimes, and a GIT_* env snapshot — best-effort and type-unchanged, so the NEXT CI occurrence pins the deleter. Withheld-oracle TDD (each forensic section RED first); 4/4 manual mutants killed.
- [x] [operator-attested] `make lint`/`make typecheck` clean; landed via Gerrit change 1769 (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1), MERGED into main.
